provenance.kind: Project-authored controlled material-physics study. All tables are stipulated model observations, not a claim of new experimental or ab-initio results.
provenance.scope: Inference is conditional on the explicit finite model, source identities, units and measurement policy.

model: Lossless nonmagnetic positive-index layers at normal incidence. One layer has characteristic matrix[[cos(delta),i*sin(delta)/n],[i*n*sin(delta),cos(delta)]],delta=2*pi*n*d/lambda. Multiply matrices in listed order. Each unit-cell matrix has determinant1. An infinite periodic medium has an evanescent Bloch gap when abs(trace(M)/2)>1; equality is a band edge, not a gap.
decay_definition: For a gap cell the decaying Bloch eigenvalue magnitude is exp(-arcosh(abs(trace(M)/2))). Find the smallest positive integer N for which its magnitude^N<=.01. This is the field-amplitude ratio of one decaying Bloch eigenmode, not incident-light power transmission.
boundary_information: No external incident/substrate refractive indices, stack termination phase or boundary coupling are supplied, so an incident-wave finite-stack transmittance cannot be released from this Bloch multiplier alone.
scope: Controlled one-dimensional coherent photonic model at one wavelength. The uniform surrogate has the same total thickness and optical path but need not have the same gap response.
